filesystem.description: Access PostgreSQL configuration files, logs, migration scripts, and backup automation scripts

github.description: Review database schema changes in pull requests, track migration history, and document optimization decisions

postgres.description: PRIMARY: Direct PostgreSQL access for EXPLAIN queries, pg_stat_* monitoring, administrative commands, and performance analysis

context7.description: Research PostgreSQL documentation, extension guides, performance tuning techniques, and community best practices

setupInstructions: Set PGHOST, PGPORT, PGDATABASE, PGUSER, PGPASSWORD for PostgreSQL connection
Set GITHUB_PERSONAL_ACCESS_TOKEN with repo scope for GitHub access
Ensure PostgreSQL server is running and accessible
Install pg_stat_statements extension: CREATE EXTENSION pg_stat_statements;
Grant necessary permissions to monitoring user

analyze_performance.example: SELECT query, calls, mean_exec_time, total_exec_time FROM pg_stat_statements ORDER BY total_exec_time DESC LIMIT 20;

monitor_connections.example: SELECT pid, usename, application_name, state, query FROM pg_stat_activity WHERE state != 'idle';

check_bloat.example: SELECT schemaname, tablename, n_dead_tup, n_live_tup FROM pg_stat_user_tables WHERE n_dead_tup > 1000 ORDER BY n_dead_tup DESC;

analyze_locks.example: SELECT locktype, relation::regclass, mode, granted, pid FROM pg_locks WHERE NOT granted;

check_cache_hit.example: SELECT sum(blks_hit)*100/sum(blks_hit+blks_read) AS cache_hit_ratio FROM pg_stat_database;

research_feature.description: Research PostgreSQL features and best practices
